summary: Get Export Options for Existing RFI
description: Get the available export options for an existing RFI.

slug.description: Machine-readable key identifying the export option group, e.g. `cover_sheet` or `files`. Pass sub-options from this group in the `options` request body when creating an export.

name.description: Human-readable label for the export option group, suitable for display in an export UI.

type.description: Selection mode for this option group. `single_select` allows exactly one option to be chosen; `multi_select` allows multiple.
